about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Aqua Engineers, Inc. (Schofield Barracks plant, Wahiawa)
channels.legal_basis: HAR 11-62 Appendix B (Responses for wastewater spills, overflows and discharges), section 9: whoever owns or runs a wastewater system reports spills, overflows and discharges to the Department of Health's Clean Water Branch (the rule's text was not read: its published copies refuse automated reads; its deadline is not quoted); permit HI0110141: HAR 11-55 (water pollution control), the NPDES permits' standard conditions: noncompliance that may endanger health or the environment is reported to the Department of Health
channels.note: Aqua Engineers, Inc. (Schofield Barracks plant, Wahiawa) reports spills, overflows and discharges to the Department of Health's Clean Water Branch. The report itself is not published; the Department's advisory for the affected waters is, in the list the feed reads (a notice names the facility when the Department gives it). No Hawaii rule requires the operator to tell the public; its own pages were not searched. (research/hi/report.md section 2)

channels.agency: Hawaii State Department of Health, Clean Water Branch
channels.name: Hawaii State Department of Health, Clean Water Branch (water quality advisories and events)
channels.authority: Hawaii State Department of Health, Clean Water Branch
channels.note: The Department's portal lists every advisory it issues (sewage spills, permit exceedances, Brown Water Advisories, beach advisories and retest notifications), open and closed, from one JSON endpoint: the newest 500 of 1,901 events on 2026-11-07 (Brown Water Advisory 279, Beach Notification 104, Beach Advisory 52, Sewage Spill 50, Permit Exceedance 15). Read every refresh by the feed. No terms or licence stated. The Department's practice; no rule requiring it was found. (research/hi/sources.json)

channels.agency: Hawaii State Department of Health, Clean Water Branch
channels.name: Hawaii State Department of Health, Clean Water Branch (e-mail notices by island)
channels.note: E-mail notices of the same advisories, by island, through the portal's subscription form; the advisories themselves are read from the portal's list. Not subscribed.

channels.agency: Hawaii State Department of Health, Clean Water Branch
channels.name: Hawaii State Department of Health, Clean Water Branch (warning signs at the water)
channels.note: No web form: the Department posts warning signs at the affected waters ("Warning signs have been posted" in its sewage spill notices) and removes them when it cancels the advisory; the portal gives the removal time. On site only.

channels.agency: Hawaii State Department of Health, Clean Water Branch
channels.name: Hawaii State Department of Health, Clean Water Branch (wastewater spill reports)
channels.legal_basis: HAR 11-62 Appendix B (Responses for wastewater spills, overflows and discharges), section 9: whoever owns or runs a wastewater system reports spills, overflows and discharges to the Department of Health's Clean Water Branch (the rule's text was not read: its published copies refuse automated reads; its deadline is not quoted); HAR 11-55 (water pollution control), the NPDES permits' standard conditions: noncompliance that may endanger health or the environment is reported to the Department of Health
channels.note: No web form: every wastewater operator, public or private, reports spills, overflows and discharges to the Clean Water Branch. The reports themselves are not published; the Department posts an advisory for the waters it judges affected (hi-doh-cwb-advisories). No Hawaii rule requires the operator to tell the public. (research/hi/report.md section 2)

channels.name: Hawaii State Department of Health (news releases)
channels.note: The Department's news releases; large spills also get a release. Answered 200 on 2026-11-07. Page health only: the advisories are read from the portal's list. Voluntary. (research/hi/sources.json hi-doh-news-releases)
